summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Cronos Gangsters Telegram Bot Dashboard. Backend APIs fully functional, frontend mostly working with minor clipboard permission issues.

resolved_issues.issue: Bot start/stop API failed due to subprocess using wrong Python environment
resolved_issues.fix_applied: Updated server.py to use /root/.venv/bin/python for subprocess calls

ui_bugs.issue: Clipboard API permission denied in automation environment
ui_bugs.note: This is expected in automation - works for real users

integration_issues.issue: UI status doesn't immediately reflect API changes after bot start/stop
integration_issues.note: May need to trigger refresh or add real-time status polling

design_issues.issue: Webpack dev server error overlay visible showing clipboard errors
design_issues.note: Development environment issue, likely not present in production
